breakdown.description: Thermal expansion coefficient beta for an ideal gas is approximately 1/T in absolute units (Kelvin); using Celsius temperature in beta = 1/T is incorrect.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the thermal expansion coefficient (beta) for an ideal gas must be calculated using absolute temperature (Kelvin), not Celsius. The generated specification calculates the film temperature as 323 K and correctly uses this value in the formula β = 1/Tf, which aligns with the ground truth.
